args.body:
• Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter covers cold-chain logistics in 2026.
• The linked article reports temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
• The companion piece adds that pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
